$comment: Tracked OpenAPI documents that no generator produces, and why. Every tracked document must be here or in generated-specs.json; check-openapi-document-closure.mjs holds that. `limit` is the ratchet — it may only fall, and it falls in the same commit that removes an entry.

packages/legal/openapi/admin/contract-do.reason: Declares no paths at all, so there is nothing to generate. Deleting it is a smaller decision than writing a generator for an empty document, and should be settled first.

packages/mice/openapi/admin/mice-booking.reason: src/booking-extension.ts mounts an OpenAPIHono app but registers plain .get/.put/.delete handlers — the app type is misleading about what it can emit. With no createRoute there is no schema to generate from; the fix is route authoring, not tooling.

packages/reporting/openapi/admin/reporti.reason: No createRoute anywhere in src — the seven paths are hand-written against plain Hono handlers, so the request and response shapes exist only as prose in this artifact.
